nodes.description: Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token ticker VLTY.
Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name 'Vaulty Coin'.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' set to 6.
Public uint state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply.
Mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token balances of every account.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' tracking ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure function performing checked addition via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure function performing checked subtraction via require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure function performing checked multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure function performing checked division via require(b > 0).
Constructor initializing symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and the owner balance, then emitting Transfer.
totalSupply() constant returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moving tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) setting allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emitting Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moving tokens using allowance of msg.sender and updating balances/allowed.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) approving spender and then invoking spender.receiveApproval(...) as an external call.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and approval target.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) in approveAndCall, transferring control to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
Parameter 'a' of safeAdd (first operand).
Parameter 'b' of safeAdd (second operand).
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of balanceOf, used as lookup key into balances.
Parameter 'to' of transfer, the destination address.
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer, the amount to move.
Parameter 'spender' of approve, the approved address.
Parameter 'tokens' of approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom, the amount to move.
Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of allowance.
Parameter 'spender' of approveAndCall, also the target contract of the external call.
Parameter 'tokens' of approveAndCall, the allowance amount forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter 'data' of approveAndCall, arbitrary bytes forwarded to the external callee.
Return local variable 'c' of safeAdd holding the addition result.
Return local variable 'success' of transfer.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines which balances entry transfer debits and is emitted in the Transfer event.
msg.sender is the owner key under which approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender indexes the spender allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as approval owner and forwarded as the 'from' argument to receiveApproval.
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer delegates the debit computation to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit computation to SafeMath.safeAdd.
transfer assigns true to its success return local variable.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance decrement.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the caller-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval, handing control to untrusted code (potential reentrancy).
The external receiveApproval invocation re-enters contract logic from the callee back into the token contract's callable functions.
Constructor assigns symbol = 'VLTY'.
Constructor assigns name = 'Vaulty Coin'.
Constructor assigns decimals = 6.
Constructor assigns _totalSupply = 60000000000000000.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances of the fixed owner address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored total supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested account.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
safeAdd consumes parameter a in the addition.
safeAdd consumes parameter b in the addition.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the balances lookup key.
transfer credits balances['to'] using the destination parameter.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as the amount to debit and credit.
approve uses spender as the second key of the allowed mapping.
approve stores the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the from parameter.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the to parameter.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter for balance and allowance math.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the first key of the allowed mapping.
allowance uses spender as the second key of the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall uses spender as allowance key and as the external call target.
approveAndCall stores and forwards the tokens parameter.
approveAndCall forwards arbitrary bytes data to the external receiveApproval call.
safeAdd computes and returns the local result variable c.
transfer returns its boolean success local variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Operand parameter a is only used inside safeAdd and carries no standalone security meaning, so it folds into the function node.
Operand parameter b is only used inside safeAdd and folds into the function node.
View lookup key used only by balanceOf, so it merges into that function.

Amount parameter used only by transfer; folded into the transfer function node.
Spender parameter used only by approve; folded into the approve function node.
Allowance amount parameter used only by approve; folded into the approve function node.
Debited account parameter used only by transferFrom; folded into that function.
Credited account parameter used only by transferFrom; folded into that function.
Amount parameter used only by transferFrom; folded into that function.
View lookup key used only by allowance; folded into that function.
View lookup key used only by allowance; folded into that function.
The spender parameter is the target of the untrusted external receiveApproval call, so it merges into the unsafe operation node.
Allowance amount parameter used only by approveAndCall; folded into that function.
Arbitrary calldata is forwarded verbatim to the external callee, so it merges into the unsafe operation node.
Return local of safeAdd with no independent security role; folded into the function node.
